cases.case_label: De novo 3756 bp LINE-1 insertion replacing a ~17 kb EYA1 deletion in branchio-oto-renal syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous de novo ~17 kb deletion running from the last eight bases of exon 4 to base 1,217 of intron 7 of EYA1 carried a 3756 bp L1 element in place of the deleted sequence. RT-PCR showed exons 4-7 were missing from the mRNA of the mutant allele. Both parents were deletion-negative by MLPA.
cases.quote: Accordingly, RT-PCR showed that exons 4-7 were not present in EYA1 mRNA expressed from the mutated allele.
